questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in passive voice.

He had cleaned the bathroom.

options.text: The bathroom has cleaned by him.
The bathroom had cleaned by him.
The bathroom had been cleaned by him.
The bathroom has been cleaned by him.

questions.solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "He had cleaned the bathroom."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the bathroom" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "had cleaned" to "had been cleaned" (past perfect passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "him."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The bathroom had been cleaned by him."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The bathroom has cleaned by him." – Incorrect tense and structure.
 
• **Option 2: **"The bathroom had cleaned by him." – Incorrect structure without the auxiliary verb "been".
 
• **Option 4: **"The bathroom has been cleaned by him." – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).

``

questions.question:
Select the option that correctly expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Why didn’t she bring her son to my house?

options.text: Why wasn’t her son brought by her to my house?
Why isn’t her son brought to my house?
Why wasn’t her son brought to my house?
Why isn’t her son brought by you to my house?

questions.solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Why didn’t she bring her son to my house?"
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "her son" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "didn’t bring" to "wasn’t brought" (past simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "her."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Why wasn’t her son brought by her to my house?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Option 3: **"Why wasn’t her son brought to my house?" – Missing the agent "by her."
 
• **Option 4: **"Why isn’t her son brought by you to my house?" – Incorrect tense and incorrect agent.
